name: Save to case file
description: Saves a text or markdown draft into the Drafts folder of the case this workspace belongs to, in SharePoint. Use this whenever the user asks to save, write, add or create a document, note or draft in the case file. The user must approve each save. The file is uploaded by the sync service a few minutes later. Never tell the user a file was saved unless this tool returned a success message.
author: Comits

examples.prompt: Save that summary to her file as initial-summary
Add a test text doc to this case with one random word in it

filename.description: File name for the draft, ending in .md or .txt. Short and descriptive, no folder paths.

content.description: The full text content of the file.
